prompt: What was the first-generation, four-speed manual transmission gearbox type of the Mazda R360 officially called in Japan?
answer: The first-generation four-speed manual gearbox was officially designated **KRBB** in Japan. (The two-speed torque-converter automatic was designated **KRBC**.)
